about: What each button does per element (2026-11-22, the Hades-style kits). Buttons: X (weapon), Y, A, B, and RT (switch). Per button: tap (pressed and let go), hold (held hold_seconds: it goes off by itself), combo (presses in a row, reset after combo_reset_seconds), charge (held, let go: longer = stronger), in_front (aimed at the tile in front of you). Heals and buffs on allies take two presses: the first picks an ally (left stick or arrows), the second casts. Edit freely; the game reads it at start.
